note: Programming rules, checked on any code the model emits. The point is not style preferences -- each rule below catches something that makes the code wrong or unrunnable, and each is checkable without executing it.

rules.rejects: unbalanced (), [], {} which cannot compile in any language
tabs and spaces mixed on different lines, which Python rejects
a keyword from another language used in Python
a line ending in a semicolon, which is a statement separator from another language
a Python block opener without its colon
a placeholder left in the code instead of an implementation
a script with no callable entry point, so the reader cannot run it
a shell command that deletes or overwrites without a guard
